openings.claim: Usable-correction payment holdback may favor authorized private self-service correction/regeneration.

decision: Probe before implementation. All paths require private authorized names, documented CSV, uninterrupted attendance entry, six engineer-days and existing hosting. Test isolation including splits; sampled safety is incomplete. Use six coordinators/two sessions; predeclare all 40 exports, count all checking/correction time, retain original success thresholds. Synthetic associations establish no causation.
